user_goal: Rapidly review, filter, assign, and triage engineering backlog items
primary_action: Keyboard-driven status update and cycle dispatch
layout_pattern: Split panel with sticky command header, compact list with contextual detail sidebar
navigation: Ultra-fast global command palette (Cmd+K) with contextual shortcut breadcrumbs
information_hierarchy: Status badge leading left, bold high-contrast title, subdued metadata aligned right
typography: Inter Display / Geist with tight tabular numeric figures (-0.02em letter spacing)
color_strategy: Deep obsidian slate (#0B0F17) with refined subtle 1px border (#1F2937) and deliberate single-color accent highlights
spacing_rhythm: 4px/8px tight modular grid with 12px compact table rows
interaction_strengths: Instant zero-latency keyboard triage (A, E, R, Space), fluid 120ms transitions
interaction_weaknesses: Can feel overwhelming for novice users without clear keyboard cheatsheet tooltip
design_principle_extracted: Speed and visual calm through monochromatic surfaces with high-contrast text and crisp 1px borders
possible_adaptation: Adopt Linear-style keyboard shortcuts and minimal high-contrast triage dock for document decisions

user_goal: Execute complex system actions and review structured outputs in single keystroke
primary_action: Filter, select, and inspect extension payload
layout_pattern: Center floating command canvas with dual split results and detail metadata drawer
navigation: Action bar anchored to footer with clearly marked shortcut key badges
information_hierarchy: Primary item highlighted with clear active state; secondary parameters grouped into clean key-value pairs
typography: JetBrains Mono for keys/tokens and Inter for labels
color_strategy: Neutral dark zinc with vibrant semantic crimson/emerald pill badges
interaction_strengths: Footer action bar always tells the reviewer what hotkeys are available
interaction_weaknesses: Requires desktop screen estate for full split view
design_principle_extracted: Discoverable shortcuts in persistent footer bar removes guesswork
possible_adaptation: Embed Raycast-style shortcut pills directly into the manual review decision bar

screen_type: Identity & Government ID Forensic Triage Console
user_goal: Review extracted passport/license data, face match scores, and barcode forensics
primary_action: Approve / Inquire / Decline identity verification case
layout_pattern: Dual-pane inspection: Left visual ID canvas with zoom/pan, Right multi-signal fraud checks
navigation: Top breadcrumbs with case ID and automated risk status badge
information_hierarchy: Risk score gauge pinned top-right, followed by biometric breakdown, then raw OCR fields
typography: Sharp geometric sans with clear distinction between verified and unverified fields
color_strategy: Dark neutral canvas with strict green/amber/red semantic indicator badges
spacing_rhythm: 16px card padding, 12px gap between signal accordions
interaction_strengths: Hovering over an extracted name or ID highlights the corresponding region on the document
interaction_weaknesses: Dense accordions can hide critical secondary signals if collapsed by default
design_principle_extracted: Bi-directional spatial linking between extracted text and document image establishes immediate proof
possible_adaptation: Implement bi-directional OCR and tampering bounding box highlights on document canvas

user_goal: Trace malware process tree, inspect anomalous memory writes, and isolate compromised hosts
primary_action: Contain host / Escalate to SOC Tier 3 / Close false positive
layout_pattern: Full-bleed forensic canvas with collapsible multi-tier evidence drawer and timeline scrub
navigation: Top severity badge with incident ID and assigned lead investigator tag
information_hierarchy: Severity level (Critical 9.8) dominates viewport, supported by MITRE ATT&CK mapping tags
typography: Monospace code blocks for memory addresses/hashes with high-contrast slate headers
color_strategy: Deep carbon theme (#0D1117) with vivid crimson threat markers and violet neural indicators
spacing_rhythm: Compact 8px spacing for high density forensic data
interaction_strengths: Visual timeline of events with exact parent-child hash linkages
interaction_weaknesses: Extremely steep learning curve for non-specialist operators
design_principle_extracted: Forensic evidence must be chronological, immutable, and traceable to an exact hash/block
possible_adaptation: Adopt CrowdStrike-style cryptographic hash chain blocks for the tamper-evident audit trail

user_goal: Inspect live serverless build logs, edge runtime metrics, and domain health
primary_action: Promote deployment / Rollback / Inspect build logs
layout_pattern: Minimalist card grid with subtle 1px border contrast and clear typographic hierarchy
navigation: Tabs with clean underline indicator and zero layout shift
information_hierarchy: Status dot (Ready, Error, Building) + Branch Name + SHA Git Commit leading
color_strategy: Pure black (#000000) and charcoal (#111111) with pristine white text and neon emerald status dots
interaction_strengths: Subtle border hover glow and crystal clear typography without visual clutter
interaction_weaknesses: Very dark theme requires high display brightness in sunlight
design_principle_extracted: Ultra-clean monochrome with single semantic dots creates an uncluttered, premium feel
possible_adaptation: Use Vercel-style typography and minimal status dots for system telemetry and queue items

user_goal: Analyze payment risk score, evaluate ML risk signals, and approve or refund transaction
layout_pattern: Two-column master-detail: Left payment summary card, Right ML risk signal breakdown
navigation: Top breadcrumbs with charge ID and risk score badge (e.g. 'Elevated Risk - 64')
information_hierarchy: Risk score slider bar with benchmark distribution, followed by itemized signal factors
typography: Custom Stripe Söhne font with high-contrast tabular numbers
color_strategy: Slate blue background with soft green (Normal), yellow (Elevated), and red (Highest Risk) meters
interaction_strengths: Transparent breakdown of why the ML model flagged the score with exact factor weights
interaction_weaknesses: Does not support spatial image zooming (text-only transactions)
design_principle_extracted: Explainable AI requires displaying both the composite score and the individual positive/negative factors
possible_adaptation: Adopt Stripe Radar's risk meter and factor breakdown for the evidence fusion panel

screen_type: Blockchain Forensic Graph & Entity Tracing Canvas
user_goal: Trace illicit wallet flows, cluster tainted transactions, and produce court-admissible audit reports
primary_action: Tag cluster / Export forensic dossier / Trace path
layout_pattern: Infinite node canvas on left, Entity classification drawer on right
navigation: Investigation case folder selector with export evidence button
information_hierarchy: Cluster label + Risk category + Tainted amount clearly highlighted
typography: Dense monospace for wallet addresses and hashes
color_strategy: Dark navy slate with orange/red cluster warning nodes and blue verified exchanges
interaction_strengths: Smooth pan-and-zoom canvas with contextual selection inspector
interaction_weaknesses: Heavy canvas rendering requires optimized WebGL or canvas rendering
design_principle_extracted: High-magnification contextual inspection provides indispensable forensic confidence
possible_adaptation: Build an optical 2.5x Loupe with Error Level Analysis (ELA) for pixel tampering verification

user_goal: Inspect vector layers, typography properties, and spatial coordinates
primary_action: Select layer / Inspect bounding box / Zoom to 100%
layout_pattern: Three-pane: Left Layer Tree | Center Infinite Canvas | Right Property Inspector
navigation: Top toolbar with zoom percentage selector and tool pickers
information_hierarchy: Canvas commands center stage, precise numerical properties in right sidebar
typography: Inter with compact 11px property labels and 12px numeric inputs
color_strategy: Neutral dark gray (#1E1E1E) with signature blue selection bounding boxes
spacing_rhythm: 8px base padding, compact 24px tool icon buttons
interaction_strengths: Spatial bounding boxes with handles and coordinate readouts make layout inspectable
design_principle_extracted: Blue vector bounding boxes with confidence labels make OCR and seal locations immediately clear
possible_adaptation: Use Figma-style blue bounding boxes for OCR lines and red boxes for tampering/seal zones

user_goal: Detect counterfeit IDs, evaluate portrait tampering, and compare barcode payload to OCR
layout_pattern: Split comparison: Front Document Scan vs Back Barcode Data vs Cross-Verification Matrix
navigation: Header with customer reference and automated verdict pill
information_hierarchy: Verdict banner leading, followed by tamper anomaly alerts and cross-check table
typography: Clean enterprise sans-serif with high contrast badges
color_strategy: Clean slate background with high-visibility red anomaly highlight boxes
interaction_strengths: Clear cross-document discrepancy table (e.g. Name on Front vs Name in Barcode)
design_principle_extracted: Cross-document discrepancy matrix makes fraud undeniable to reviewers
possible_adaptation: Build a Cross-Document Portfolio Verifier comparing Degree vs Transcript vs LOR entities

user_goal: Review secret leaks, static code analysis alerts, and dismiss or create fix PR
primary_action: Dismiss alert with reason / Create fix issue
layout_pattern: Master alert list with facet filters, detail view with highlighted code snippet and rule explanation
navigation: Repository security tab with severity filter chips (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
information_hierarchy: Vulnerability title + Severity badge + File path + Exact line highlight
typography: GitHub Mona Sans and Monospace code block with diff highlights
color_strategy: Dark GitHub slate (#0D1117, #161B22) with purple Dependabot and red security badges
interaction_strengths: Dismissing an alert requires selecting a standardized reason code for audit compliance
interaction_weaknesses: Code view can be constrained in narrow split viewports
design_principle_extracted: Every manual override must enforce selecting a standardized reason code and logging an audit note
possible_adaptation: Incorporate standardized fraud reason dropdown in the reviewer decision dock

user_goal: Inspect database records, execute queries, and configure RBAC policies
primary_action: Filter table / Insert row / Edit cell
layout_pattern: Sidebar navigation with collapsible sections, high-density data grid with sticky table headers
navigation: Left icon rail with secondary collapsible project menu
information_hierarchy: Table name + Schema tag top-left, Filter and Sort bar center, Action buttons top-right
typography: Custom circular sans with monospace numbers and IDs
color_strategy: Dark emerald-tinted charcoal (#1C1C1C) with vibrant green (#3ECF8E) accents and muted borders (#2E2E2E)
interaction_strengths: Sticky table headers and fast inline filtering without full page reloads
interaction_weaknesses: Dense tables require horizontal scroll on smaller laptop screens
design_principle_extracted: Sidebar with collapsible icon rail maximizes horizontal space for the main workspace
possible_adaptation: Use collapsible icon-and-label sidebar navigation for all 13 application screens

user_goal: Review applicant identity document, liveness video check, and sanctions watchlist hit
layout_pattern: Applicant profile header + 3-column triage (Document Scan | Face Match | Watchlist & Risk Signals)
navigation: Queue progress ticker (e.g. 'Case 14 of 32 in Review Queue')
information_hierarchy: Overall applicant status badge top center, individual module checkmarks below
color_strategy: Clean dark slate with green pass checkmarks and yellow warning icons
interaction_strengths: Queue progress counter ('Case 14 of 32') helps reviewers track daily workload SLA
interaction_weaknesses: Three columns can feel cramped on screens below 1600px width
design_principle_extracted: Queue counter and SLA indicator provide immediate context on triage progress
possible_adaptation: Add live queue position indicator and SLA countdown badge to the top case bar
